getApp.body.en:
Reporting waits and problems is only available in the PickupRadar mobile app.

The preview on this website is read-only.
getApp.body.text:
Okuloopa okulinda n’ebizibu kukolebwa mu app ya ssimu eya PickupRadar yokka.

Ekyokulabirako ku mukutu guno kya kulaba kyokka.

getApp.cityAlert.en:
Get a launch alert when {city} goes live.

Launch alerts are set up in the mobile app.
getApp.cityAlert.text:
Funa amawulire {city} bw’etandika.

Amawulire g’okutandika gateekebwateekebwa mu app ya ssimu.

getApp.cityRequest.en:
Ask for PickupRadar in your city.

City requests are sent from the mobile app.
getApp.cityRequest.text:
Saba PickupRadar mu kibuga kyo.

Okusaba kw’ebibuga kuweerezebwa okuva mu app ya ssimu.

saved.appOnly.en: Saving pickup points is available in the mobile app.
saved.appOnly.text: Okutereka ebifo eby’okuyingiza kusangibwa mu app ya ssimu.

home.noVenues.body.en: No active pickup points found for this city.
home.noVenues.body.text: Tewali bifo bya kuyingiza bikola bizuuliddwa mu kibuga kino.

location.useButton.text: Kozesa ekifo kyange okulaba ebifo eby’okuyingiza ebiri okumpi
